textos.equipo.intro: Each team is compared only with its own previous 12 weeks. Never with other teams or by people.
textos.todos.intro: The area as a whole, against its own history. And each team against its own: no rankings.
textos.pmo.intro: Predictability, data health and open cases for each team.
textos.negocio.intro: How long a request takes and where each team's capacity goes.
textos.comparacion.aviso: Compares only normalised measures, within the same task type and size. It does not measure effort, difficulty or people. A difference is a question for the meeting, not a ranking.
textos.iniciativa.aviso: It is not a controlled experiment: it says whether it is worth continuing, it does not prove the cause.
textos.agentes.aviso: It is calculated on the ticket text in this browser. Only aggregate figures leave, never the text.
textos.iniciativas.intro: Each initiative, with the before and after of its measure, against the teams that do not take part.
textos.agentes.intro: How much of the new work an AI agent could complete without asking.
